title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Built for the long game or living for the plot? Discover your clock personality and a just-for-fun age estimate.

landing.intro:
One surprising result.
What age will you get?

about.body:
Meet the personality behind your everyday habits. Choose what you actually do, then see a small profile preview after each chapter. Your final result brings together your clock type and a playful age estimate.

A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, and another is offered after each chapter to continue or reveal your result. The optional answer breakdown has its own rewarded ad. Progress is saved on this device so you can come back to it.

The age is an entertainment score based on your choices, not a forecast. The quiz does not use your current age, medical records, family history or an individual risk assessment. Your final instinct can shift the displayed estimate by no more than one year.

steps: Tap the answer that sounds like the real you. There are no right answers.
See the personality leading each chapter, then explore a new side of your routine.
Reveal your clock type and playful age estimate, then explore the choices behind it.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not predict lifespan, health, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

centenarian_energy.title: The Long-Game Legend
centenarian_energy.copy: You make small promises and actually keep them. Your answers favour repeatable habits, room to recover and choices that tomorrow-you will appreciate. Your signature: quietly playing the long game.

steady_long_game.title: Steady By Nature
steady_long_game.copy: You know the value of a routine that feels like yours. Familiar rituals and dependable people give your days their shape. Your signature: being the person others can count on, without making a big production of it.

balanced_realist.title: The Balanced Realist
balanced_realist.copy: You make room for sensible choices and a life worth enjoying. Your answers adapt to the day instead of chasing a perfect routine. Your signature: knowing when to stick to the plan and when to order the cake.

weekend_chaos.title: The Weekend Wildcard
weekend_chaos.copy: Your best stories rarely begin with a strict plan. Your answers lean toward spontaneous moments, good company and the occasional negotiation with tomorrow-you. Your signature: turning an ordinary evening into a story.

stress_sprinter.title: The Full-Speed Soul
stress_sprinter.copy: You bring momentum to almost everything. Your answers often put the next task ahead of the next pause. Your signature: getting things moving. A little more breathing room could make that pace feel more like a choice.

comfort_creature.title: Comfort Royalty
comfort_creature.copy: You know exactly what makes a day feel good: familiar places, favourite people and a proper chance to switch off. Your signature: making ordinary life feel welcoming. There is skill in knowing what suits you.

adventure_fuse.title: The Plot Chaser
adventure_fuse.copy: Curiosity gets a vote in your decisions. Your answers find possibility in new places, odd ideas and days that take an unexpected turn. Your signature: coming back with a story nobody saw coming.

reset_needed.title: The Comeback Chapter
reset_needed.copy: Your answers often ask for more room, fewer demands and a chance to catch your breath. Your signature right now: wanting a fresh start that fits real life. Your clock type is a snapshot of these choices, not a permanent label.
